name: Fountaine Pajot Saona 47
description: Refitted in 2026, with four double cabins, a cabin with bunk beds and air conditioning in all of them. The flybridge has its own lounge, so half the group can read in the shade up there while the other half is already out on a paddleboard. The watermaker means a fresh shower after every swim, wherever you're anchored.
